Material: Conductive Adhesive
Family: adhesive
Specification: N/A
Environment: Air, <10^-6 torr
Temperature: 70.0°F
Pressure: N/A PSIA
Habitable: False
Issue: offgassing, flammability
Application: This material is used to secure the corrector plate lens to the optics subassembly. Good thermal conductivity is required for thermal control. This material is contained within the optics subassembly. This material is applied per JPL Specification DM509306, Vol. 2, Para. 3.2.5. A 2% by volume of catalyst 59 is added. It is cured at 149°C for 6 hours and at 200°C for 12 hours. See Attachment G for detailed description. JPL Specification is 0.16% TML, 0.08% VCM.

Category: I
Determination: APPROVED
Rationale: Outgassing is not an issue since the JPL cure schedule permits the adhesive to meet requirements. Furthermore, adhesive is not exposed but contained within the bondline. Flammability is not an issue since such small quantities are used, flame could not be sustained; material is in bondline and air is excluded and finally the bonded components (glass and aluminum) act as a massive heat sink.
